entities.name: Viking Expansion
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The Norse expansion (c. 793–1066) through raiding, trading, and settling across Europe, the North Atlantic, and beyond. Vikings reached Constantinople, Baghdad, North America (Vinland), and founded Normandy, Kievan Rus, and Iceland.
